english: The minotaurs are southeast of here. Good hunting, friend.
The monstrosity came from the bottom of the lake. Wait for it to lower its guard, then strike!
The more food she eats, the faster she'll calm down!
The more of these we turn on, the more chak they'll attract. So, yeah... Math!  Deadly math!
The mortal body is a poor vessel for the immortal soul.
The most obvious one isn't always the best.
The most we had to worry about was her leaving a little slime trail when she followed us around the ship.
The mount race is about to begin! Would you like me to add your name to the list of competitors?
The mursaat betrayed us and murdered my men, and then dragged me to this terrible place.
The natural power of lightning "pacifies" the local fauna and makes harvesting a breeze!
The nearby flames are preventing damage from frostbite.
The new batch does seem promising, though they're still young.
The next golem battle at Battleground Plaza. If everything goes according to my plan, I have zero doubt my golem will claim victory. Only a braindead skritt would doubt Incinergen's success!
The next krewe I join will be someplace nicer than this festering boil of an island.
The night sky is so pretty to look at through a telescope.
The northern organ is destroyed.
The nose, the palate, the finish...so balanced!
The number of defectors who are ready for Jimoh to guide them to safety in the north.
The offerings are working! The whispers are being driven from the shrine!
The ogre advance into the chak nest was successful. Nokta is waiting, tending the eggs.
The ogres are northwest of here, and nobody knows when the raid is happening. Are you going with them?
The ogres would have taken them south into Wildlin Narrows. That is where Otyugh keeps his pets. Please, I don't want anything unpleasant to befall them.
The older kids get to do so much stuff. It's not fair. I want a baby junundu!
The one that got away, the last mursaat, is still out there, waiting for his chance to bring Kryta to its knees before him. He has hidden himself well, but we will know the moment he emerges.
The one you're looking for, Isgarren. He's just ahead. But, I worry that...
The only absolutely guilty parties are those who kidnapped these sylvari.
The only enemy more evil than the mursaat are the White Mantle, for they are Krytans who have inflicted their own people, their own families, with the worst kind of suffering. They deserve no mercy.
The ooze isn't making any hostile moves toward you. It appears to be tame.
The oppressive heat has slowed your movement speed by 55%%. Your endurance-regeneration rate has been lowered by 90%%.
The orb has appeared.
The other Priory members... You said they headed east?
The other day I was hunting chak for their enzyme, had a whole satchel full, when I was attacked by the terrible Xocotl!
The other portals should've fallen by now. I wonder how the other demolitionists are doing.
The others, they heard the whispers but did not listen. They tried—they tried so hard. But time ran out.
The outpost is quiet for the moment, Commander.
The overlook is being sieged by legion forces!
The overlook is under attack!
The overlord is defeated! Fall back. That's enough for now.
The overseer's aura has weighed you down and slowly ticks away your health. Movement speed is reduced by 10%%.
The pages are filled with text, but the words seem to fade as you try to read them and reappear when you look away.
The paper is of rough linen, folded into a bookmark. It is blank.
The path takes us past a chak hive, though. I'll need some help reaching it!
The path to serenity is fraught with peril, especially in these days. I fear even for the strong of heart.
The patrols are more frequent. We must be getting close.
The pedestal would be perfect for displaying presents I've given to Aurene.
The pillars of the Shining Blade are loyalty, courage, and service. Loyalty and service to Kryta and the Shining Blade, courage in the face of threat.
The pirate captain will calm down in: %str1%
The pirates said quaggan was too slow, couldn't fight, and wasn't smart. They never gave quaggan a chance. Quaggan can be strong. Quaggan just needs the opportunity.
The plants are surrounded by some beasts that don't take kindly to intruders. I'm more of a researcher than a fighter, you see.
The play might actually be good this year.
The plunger won't budge. A red light blinks near its base. On closer examination, it appears no charges have been set.
The point of intelligence is to help us make informed decisions before we commit our resources.
The poisons that coat our arrows are also a gift from Ameyalli. They come from the plants around us...and our own bodies.
The port is being sieged by legion forces!
The portal to Kormir's sanctuary has been reopened.
The power is leaving me. No, I'm not done!
The power surge from the ley line power relay acted like a magnet, drawing in massive amounts of chak. We're doomed. This will be my final entry. May the Alchemy recycle the energy of my soul.
The power-stone panel and aetheric field are inaccessible while the generator's casing is closed.
The presence of the rotten tree weighs on your heart, slowing your movement.
The professor might not come across as the gracious type, but on behalf of the Priory, I thank you for your help here.
The professor's a bit of a jerk.
The pull of the tornado is especially powerful.
The punishment for this heinous crime is death, pure and simple.
The pylons, once activated, will recall enchanted armors to aid in our defense.
The queen will close her door in: %str1%
The race has already started. Would you like to join the race in progress?
The race is beginning! Get ready!
The rapid rebuilding, growth, and advancement of New Kaineng has pushed civilization to the edge of the Echovald Wilds.
The rat king spins quickly, deflecting any attacks. Apply conditions to overcome him!
The ravenous wanderer has been broken! Finish it off for good.
The raw power...emanating from that Kryptis... It's going to take all of my focus to keep it vulnerable to your attacks.
The reddest kind, tilled straight from the soil itself. You'll find none better. Not even at Farmer Eda's orchard. You should go there now, see for yourself.
The relays supply power to the golem. Toss or place the cores to transmit their energy!
The remains of a battered journal lie abandoned in the grass. The few surviving pages are barely legible. On the cover, someone has written in an elegant hand, "Chronicling the Separation."
The renowned golemancer Zinn was sentenced to 10 years of banishment from asuran lands. Other than attempted regicide, his most notable work was the P.O.X.'s Reactor Blast.
The resonance of the bells flows through you. Use it to help cleanse the spirits and set them free.
The rest of you—clear out those Mordrem snipers!
The result of too much time in the sun. This tanner needs aloe gel!
The rite connected all dwarves' minds so that they could be stronger together. They became one Great Dwarf instead of many weak ones.
The rot spreads. If only...
The royal palace is under the protection of the Shining Blade. Queen Jennah periodically holds public audiences, but seeing her outside one of those requires a royal summons.
The royals made you fodder for Balthazar, but I'll make you soldiers!
The ruins are filled with the tombs and remains of an ancient people. If you find any relics or tablets from deep inside the crypt containing their history please bring them to me.
The ruins' automated defenses currently see us as enemies. We'll need a functional interface to reconfigure them, which is exactly what this golem would be—if it wasn't broken.
The same way that you do, Commander. I've watched your career with admiration, seen the choices you've had to make.
The scary dragon wants to eat quaggan! It wants to eat you! It wants to eat everything! Pooooo!
The scientific potential of that much ley energy is intoxicating!
The sculpture you were making in class looked amazing.
The seal on the statue of Dwayna must be broken.
The seers used crystals to help redirect the ley lines—I observed similar mechanisms while scouting the aqueduct.
The seneschal has been subdued and returned to its slumber.
The sensor's showing heat on our right side. Get ready!
The sentries are under attack!
The shiny men will say you did it. You were fooled by them. And they'll kill you, too.
The shrine is secured. Ryland's forces are retreating!
The siege engines at Fort Huduh and the Forged Firebase have been destroyed. Wayward Watch is now safe from siege attacks.
The silence of the Six Gods! These Durmand Priory folk are coming up with all these theories to explain it. Such a waste of time.
The skiff race is about to begin! Would you like me to add your name to the list of competitors?
The skimmer is being driven back to its pen.
The skritt are annoying little rat-men. They come into our camps and steal whatever isn't too heavy for them to carry. Just recently they stole the lumbermill's tools.
The skritt attacked not long ago, and ran off with all of our logging tools. Valerius is outside of Windloss Delves, south of here. If you're looking to help, I can give you directions.
The skritt remind me of you in a way, Sieran. Impulsive and reckless, but also brave. And they love life. Every bit of it.
The sky rains destruction upon you!
The smell of rot and decay saps away your life.
The snow you are carrying is melting in the warmth of your hands. Return it to Nicabar Steelweaver before it's all gone!
The sooner we reach the rally point with these supplies, the better.
The sooner you bring me beetle parts, the sooner I can start my stew—er, research.
The sound of the rain. The taste of the water. The feel of the ground beneath my feet.
The southern organ is destroyed.
The southern survey has failed. The team is returning to camp.
The southern survey team has setup camp at the Laboratory. Further research is being conducted.
The spirit of Karina is currently possessing you in hopes that you will reunite her with Lyla.
The spirit of the pack is with you.
The spirit releases a wave of spiritual energy in a ring centered at their location, dealing heavy damage to enemies within.
The spirit will go back to sleep in: %str1%
The spirits of those killed on the stone are held within its energy field, unable to depart. In history, these souls were forced into auxiliary storage devices by our ancestors.
The spore clusters aren't ripe enough to gather yet.
The steward body is very heavy.
The steward has taken a defensive position and is expelling ambient magic. Apply conditions and disrupt it by throwing the ambient magic at it!
The steward headpiece is crackling with energy.
The still-powered generator sends a sharp electrical shock through your body.
The storm is here. Keep your spear sharp and ready.
The storm will be on us soon. Reinforce defenses!
The strange aura in this place is nearly overwhelming. You can barely move.
The strange aura in this place is sickening. You feel weak, nauseated, and unable to move quickly.
The sulfur crystals are waning—we're running out of time. Quickly, bring me more.
The sun god defends.
The sun god gives us light.
The sun god gives us warmth.
The sun god protects.
The sun shines a little brighter, thanks to you. I've been so tense lately, but now, I can relax a bit. It's a good feeling.
The sun shines through all things, but the light shines most true through the great beasts that represent each of Caledon's tribes. The Zopatl are represented by Meztli the great crab.
The sun's setting! Get ready!
The survey team has found a location to begin the final steps of the survey and gather samples for research. Help protect the golems gathering air samples.
The survey team has found a location to begin the final steps of the survey and gather samples for research. Help them tranquilize and analyze creatures in the region.
The sylvari have revealed their true faces as servants of the dragon.
The sylvari! They brought fern hounds! And plant turrets, too! Those'll help!

The symbols on the vase are barely legible and seem to represent a lengthy speech of some sort. The vase is too damaged for the speech itself to be deciphered, even by the most knowledgable of scholars.
The system is completely fried. I don't know how long it'll take to get these turrets back up.
The table is scattered with tools and devices Oola must have used to calibrate her golem crystals. The ancient nature of the technology is astounding.
The tarnished traitor's paying his debt by letting us practice combat with him. He's quite good. See if you can beat him.
The teacher says to work extra hard for King Joko.
The teachers are being far too lenient. We should be training more.
The teachers don't like it when you challenge them.
The temple will give me peace.
The text of this book, written by a hylek alchemist, describes in lurid detail how to extract toxins from hylek glands.
The time has come to move.
The time is at hand.
The titan has hardened its armor, reducing all damage to zero and preventing conditions from applying.
The toll for crossing our bridge is your life.
The tome hums with magic from Central Tyria.
The tome hums with magic from all over Tyria.
The tome hums with magic from major destinations around Tyria.
The tome hums with magic from the Heart of Maguuma.
The tome hums with magic from the Icebrood Saga.
The tome shows you multiple visions of locations you can visit.
The translator concludes that the jotun were implying that the constellations themselves are altered by awakening of Elder Dragons.
The translator explains: The Elder Dragons represent a force much larger than their material form would suggest. Their awakening moves the Antikytheria, which in turn has tangible effects.
The trees create duplicates of people to serve Mordremoth. It was awful.
The trek makes for a fine constitution, I say!

The trinkets here are well-preserved, but they all seem to have been left by corsairs and thieves. There's nothing of interest to me or the Priory. You're free to take anything that might be of use to you.
The troll had to die to make the road safe for travelers. That said, I can't help but feel a little sorry for him.
The troll is shielding the vine!
The troops are almost ready. Can I count on you for the assault, or are you getting too old for this kind of thing?
The true value of this location is its secrecy. But, go ahead and ask.
The truth is, as high as the price is to learn what we've learned, I've never regretted it.
The undead are all riled up. I don't know what started it but Watchman Christophe is looking for people to finish it. Tell you the truth, they make me really nervous.
The undead are everywhere. Some days, it feels hopeless. Wave after wave of them. Every night is a night of discovery, waiting to see if we'll live to see the dawn.
The undead are here in full force. We're attempting to study them, but it hasn't been easy.
The undead are planning something. Mark my words: they won't be content holing up in Murkvale.
The undead have been driven back, but there's extensive damage.
The undead just keep coming, don't they?
The undead just keep on coming. As soon as we kill one wave, a fresh crop of walking corpses takes their places.
The unstable rift is distorting its surroundings and tearing through the fabric of this dimension. A technomagical asuran rifle might patch this up.
The very leaves on the trees are aflutter with gratitude for your heroism, %str1%. I am at your service.
The vibrations of the transport tank have driven this creature to the surface. It's in a foul mood.
The vine gates are gone. Betcha the watchpost lighting up did that.
The vinewrath springsappers were using the water's magical properties to enlarge that thrasher!
The voice from the ether whispers, "You'll find the next stone by the stacked objects that defy the oldest law."
The volcano is active. Inquest forces are harnessing Destroyer essence.
The war effort needs a constant flow of provisions. Weapons, armor, food, even magical trinkets can help our soldiers keep fighting. Talk to our master craftsmen to find out what you can do.
The war is over. Maybe they need more time to let it sink in.
The warden took Emara. We have to save her. There are others imprisoned, too.
The warden's minions were in pain.
The water it contains is especially effective for various potions and concoctions.
The waterfalls here run strong, imbued as they are with the power of our Aspects. You'll not be able to simply run through them.
The waters here are long frozen, and my people can't join Koda when we're summoned. So we built these shrines.
The way back should be clear enough from here.
The weak are not fit to serve His Majesty King Joko. You must correct this mistake.
The weapon supplies have arrived at Orr. The assault on the gate is about to begin.
The whispered voice repeats, "Find the stone in the shadow of the paean beginning with "me", and concluding with "u".
The whispering shadow has consumed life-fire from a player. Each effect consumed will be returned to a nearby player once Whispering Shadow's defiance has been broken.
The whispering shadow is targeting you with Guttering Light and will remove your life-fire if not interrupted.
The whispers have quieted. An uneasy calm falls over the lake.
The wilds must have damaged his mind. It happens. A norn hunts so much that he becomes an animal. Keep your wits about you, or you will lose them in the ice and snow.
The winds of this inlet grow ever fiercer. They're battering bridges faster than I'm able to repair them.
The wizards are reactive creatures. They scare easily. Tell them, and it could end badly for both of us.
The words of the centaur sage Ventari are carved into this stone. More than a relic, the tablet is the moral foundation of sylvari society.
The words on the data key are written in a code you can't decipher. Perhaps a device created by the manufacturer could read it?
The world needs more selfless-hero types in it. Thank you.
The world's changing. Maybe finding a new home wouldn't be so bad.
The worsening storm
The wreck of the Dead Ship Harbinger, the first Dead Ship ever defeated. Sunk in 1231 AE by the Salma's Grace, a Krytan ship, and the Pride, captained by Cobiah Marriner.
The writing ends on a torn edge.
The writing on this tablet is indecipherable. It seems to move and twist, making it impossible to read.
The xenophobic organization **DATA MISSING** have nearly assumed full control of Cantha.
The...fractals. I can't believe I made explorable chunks of reality from the Mists. I've dreamed of doing it for  so long. Now, it's real.
The...skills you learned could be valuable in other occupations.
Their emotions will be neutralized? Is that safe?
Their fancy tech's about as good as a pair of oars on a galleon!
Their jungle has failed them.
Their jungle withers before Mordremoth.
Their leader's making a last stand.
Their leader's trying to rally!
Their march is ceaseless...mindless, even. They don't act like a wolf or lowlander.
Their resting place is nearby. Will you take me there?
Then Dwayna spoke. "Lay down your weapons. As I have done unto you, you must do for your bretheren. Offer protection to the weak. Give solace and shelter to those in need."
Then I will turn my hatred on the Forged for now. And maybe, when this is all over, I'll think about forgiving you.
Then I'll let you return to your revelry.
Then I'll reactivate the ancient defenses and sit back as the lasers do their work.
Then don't think about it.
Then haul their cages up into the strong wind.
Then it looks like I have some cleaning to do.
Then it's even more important than ever we convince them to join the exodus north.
Then it's in good hands. See you.
Then let's get offensive. Everyone! It's time to move!
Then let's keep moving.
Then she is dead, and we must slay the abomination that occupies her form.
Then take charge or learn to compromise.
Then that leaves you, Rytlock. You here for pleasure, punishment, or both?
Then that leaves you, Tribune. You here for pleasure, punishment, or both?
Then the islands will blow, and the destroyers—well, I'd prefer not to think about that.
Then they...process them into more Mordrem somehow. It's part prison camp, part minion factory.
Then we cross our fingers that we jump start the magic echo and don't blow ourselves to smithereens.
Then what did you do?
Then you are a heathen, doomed to wander the Mists for eternity, lost and alone. I cannot help you.
Then you shall die like one!
Then you'll need a good tracker. Take Scruffy here, my best hound. He can spot his prey in the dark at 100 paces.
Then you're in the right place.
There are a lot of interesting things, aren't there? Thank you for your answer, and look forward to seeing the results in our holo-news!
There are bundles of loot hidden all around the area. Once the treasure hunt begins, see how many you can grab before time runs out.
There are cracks in this boulder. Maybe Admiral Clarinda Demard knows a way to break it open.
There are hungry soldiers out there who could use a decent meal. Not to mention all the little cubs starving in Cantha. I'd rather send the beef to them instead of the drunkards at Butcher's Block.
There are little men inside his head who take turns controlling him.
There are many chak to our south.
There are many new faces here, my friend. The gathering of soldiers must be going well.
There are old Rata Novus defenses here which can be reactivated with the right knowledge.
There are others, but we are few and the Brand is large. Look for our light as you venture deeper, and we'll offer you what short solace we can.
There are slash marks. It looks like she's been...gone for a while. Someone went to the trouble of burying her.
There are so many voices... They're speaking all at once.
There are too many blasted chak near the city! Slay them, and you'll have our eternal thanks!
There are too many chak around here.
There are too many undead! We need to seal the gate!

There are two groups of sylvari east of here. Carmel leads the group over at the Old Sledge Site, where they're cleaning up pollution from the Inquest's more disgusting experiments. The other group has settled at Judgment Rock, but the Inquest members at Aquabase Terror-Seven aren't happy about it. Please lend the sylvari a hand. With the Inquest's attention focused there, they won't notice our plans to attack the Infinity Coil.
There are two scrolls in the pile. "Arah: City of the Gods" and "The Tragedy of Malchor."
There are two scrolls in the pile. One is a merchant's travel journal entitled "Everyday Magic in Orr" and the other a research paper with the heading, "Signets."
There are two scrolls in the pile: "The Sinking of Orr" and "Orr Rises Again."
There has to be a way.
There is a centaur war beast rampaging through Ascalon Settlement!
There is little of note here.
There is no coming back from the fires of purgation.
There is no evil so great as that of the mursaat and those who follow them. Never ever forget the horrors they inflicted on our people. The moment your anger fades, you become vulnerable.
There is nothing here for you.
There is power in unity!
There isn't a bridge in Tyria I can't fix.
There isn't much time. The warden is coming.
There isn't much to tell. For me, the Dream was almost empty. I remember hearing and feeling things, but my sight was always muddled. So I help the Wardens when I can, but I tend to get lost.
There may be something nearby that could improve it. Wouldn't take much...
There must be more shiny nearby. In that cave, yes!
There must be some trick to deactivating it.
There must be someplace that's clear of interference...
There must be something around here that can patch these leaks.
There sure seem to be a lot of skritt at this party.
There we go! It's powered down!
There we go, good as new. Now maybe it'll stay fixed for a while.
There were more like you. Plant-folk. Sylvari. They're waiting for us at Hanto Trading Post.
There won't be anything left by the time they're done!
There you are. Heard anything new?
There! Awakened are rising from the water!
There! It rises! Golem, commence murder routine 17!
There! It's the Pact! We can use those turrets to take out the destroyers!
There! On the northeast outcropping! Don't let her get away!
There! That's my mount!
There! The Olmakhan made it! Their magic should be more than enough to turn the tide. Let's go!
There's a band called Metal Legion here! And...some kind of fire...thing! Oh! And FREE ALE!
There's a dirty, beaten-up pair of Sunspear gloves here.
There's a dusty Sunspear breastplate here.
There's a group of centaurs who volunteered to help. Uncharacteristic, but appreciated.
There's a heavily defended Risen post southeast of here. If we take that position, the Pact will control this whole area.
There's a low bellowing noise coming from this Kryptis. Is it hungry?
There's a monster scattering toxic injectors in the area. If it finds me, I know it will kill me. I have to get out of here as soon as it's clear. You should too.
There's a natural choke point in the tunnel ahead. Let's slam the door shut on those Forged scum.
There's a norn in the mine, bellowing about glory and single combat.
There's a possessed elemental wreaking havoc in the area. Someone please take it out.
There's a race currently going. You can still join if you want, but I don't know that you'll be able to catch up with the others.
There's also this assortment of Mordrem parts. (15 Bandit Crests)
There's always something happening.
There's ammunition all around us. We'll throw rocks if we must!
There's an Order of Whispers emblem on the door. You can press it to exit the homestead.
There's an empty jar here. It still carries a trace of the rage it once held.
There's an empty jar here. You feel a sense of anticipation and eagerness when you reach for it.
There's an energy signature here that shouldn't—why, what does it look like I'm doing?
There's another one! Thank you.
There's art in everything.
There's mist essence nearby to be had. Find it so we can summon ourselves a hero.
There's no ease in corruption.
There's no need to be rash, but order must be maintained. I'll...commute their sentences to exile.
There's no telling where this journey will take me. I have achieved the greatest feat of any golemancer: I am one with my OOL-99L. When I die, my essence will carry on with it.
There's no use resisting.
There's no way I'm going to lose to that arrogant jerk.
There's no way our house will ever lose the Crescent Cadet Classic.
There's no way we can ever repay you.
There's not enough damage to indicate a siege. The doors and gates are all still intact.
There's nothing King Joko can't do!
There's nothing here for you, %str2%. Only norn may cross this threshold.
There's nothing in this test too crazy for me—I've seen it all!
There's our backup!
There's something else I want to talk to you about.
There's still much to do to make Tyria a better place. I'll find something.
There's still time to watch our security team in action as they eradicate a foolish, errant insect in the western quadrant.
There's stirring in the crypts. Muster every able soldier!
There's such an excess of energy out there, all the old rule books are being rewritten. Oh, look! The next wave is ready!
There's the portal that ate my rifle!
There's the temple. Apparently the bell inside used to summon a guardian, but the guardian disappeared.
There, Dawkkurra found other stuff for shop. Gold rod can have mirror keys back.
There, look! Pact reinforcements, finally! Now let's get that artillery firing!
There. Now, with the area clear, I can signal the team and we can get this expedition going!
There. They have joined us. We must get them back to Cymbel's Rescue. Quickly.
These Nuhoch are barbarians. They resist the power of the Sun!
These Pale Reavers will never turn against Tyria.
These White Mantle guards aren't affected by the bloodstone like the others I've fought.
These ancient notes have been given over to the flow of time.
These ancient statues appear to be missing their weapons.
These are dark times, friend of quaggans. Be careful.
These are the strongest and bravest of all the Legions. The very best of us.
These beetles belong to the sun god now!
These bombs do much damage. Use your glider and drop them on the octovine!
These cursed dredge are finished. We'll drive them out of these mines for good!
These details, the level of craftsmanship...just incredible.
These detestable trees! That's why Zojja and Logan were brought here!
These dredge give skritt a run for the money in the ugly and annoying contest. Help me chase them out of here.
These drivers are merciless!
These earthcallers can summon powerful elementals. Might just be enough to smash that ice wall.
These eggs are our gift to you on behalf of Zintl, the sun god.
These guys are tougher than I thought!
These hands are for forging, holding a mug of ale, or both! In fact, I'm a master of drunken forging. If you help me out, I'll return the favor by forging you some excellent weapons.
These heretics have grown too strong, and we need reinforcements. Pull back...for now.

These hills aren't lush enough for cattle, but they're perfect for raising devourers. We've also opened up an old mine, which proves to be both a great source of ore and an outlet for prison labor. But this will all mean nothing if we can't stop Flame Legion from blocking the roads we use to supply the front lines.
These humans met a terrible end. They're confused. Angry.
These idiots are all trampling evidence.
These invaders. I hear they are merciless warriors.
These locals don't know real sacrifice. They've never truly lost anything because they've never had anything worth taking.
These look like supplies from Brackwater, better return them.
These magics are incredibly delicate. If I fall, they will be lost and we'll have to start all over again.
These mechs have automated safety protocols. They'll shut down before inflicting, or receiving, critical damage. By agreeing to this test, you waive any and all liability against Xunlai Jade.
These moots are pretty diverting.
These mushrooms sprouted recently. It's odd that they're defenseless and in the open.
These old relics hold the secret of the Gilded Hollow. I just know it.
These opponents will test you in ways you never thought possible. Adversaries both exotic and challenging! Who will you face?
These ought to soften up any Mordrem that dare attack us!
These people are liars. They're just here to take your money. Look, I have evidence!
These people think they can protect us from the Forged, from Balthazar. Nothing they can do compares to his power.
These people trust you, Crecia. You saw how they fought by your side.
These progeny of mine are the most troublesome bunch I've ever been issued. But they also have great potential. I only wish they would be more cautious in their studies.
These puny skritt have wobble-arms! Can't hit simple targets, even still ones. They pretty lame. Need guidance, poor things.
These refugees won't be a burden, will they, squirt?
These rocks appear to have some sort of magical property about them.
These scrolls are part of a work called "A Land of Kings."
These skimmers are pretty useful, eh? Certainly beats moving the rocks by hand, believe me.
These spirits are old. These people died a long time ago—well before the war.
These tracks are fresh.
These unbelievers are beyond saving.
